public_rationale: DeepMind documented AI helping research in representation theory in December 2021. This predates FunSearch and directly establishes that AI had already helped with mathematics.
limitations: This does not adjudicate the narrower claim that FunSearch was a first for LLM-based mathematical discovery.
Identifying the earliest AI contribution is unnecessary to settle this claim.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: FunSearch is not the first time AI has helped with mathematics.

statement.excerpt: It’s also hardly the first time AI is helped with mathematics.
statement.document_title: Sorry, but FunSearch probably isn’t a milestone in scientific discovery

our_interpretation: The grammatical slip is read as AI has helped with mathematics.
AI includes machine learning generally; the claim is not restricted to LLMs.
One documented mathematical contribution before FunSearch is sufficient to establish that it was not the first.
The historical interval ends before FunSearch's December 14, 2023 publication and has no specified starting date.
criteria.support_condition: A documented use of AI that contributed to mathematical research predates FunSearch.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The proposed predecessors do not involve AI contributing to mathematics, and credible historical evidence establishes FunSearch as the first such contribution.
